'''Futagoyama Kofun''' (二子山古墳) is the name of several {{ill|Kofun|ca|Kofun|cs|Kofun|da|Kofun|de|Kofun|eo|Kofun|es|Kofun|fa|کوفون|fi|Kofun|fr|Kofun|he|קופון (רוגם)|hr|Kofun (grobnica)|it|Kofun|ja|古墳|ko|고훈|my|ခိုဖွန်း|pl|Kofun (kurhan)|pt|Kofun|ru|Кофун (захоронение)|simple|Kofun|th|โคฟุง|tr|Kofun|uk|Кофун|zh|古墳|qid=Q1141225|lt=Kofun}} in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan}}.

* {{ill|Ide Futagoyama Kofun|ja|井出二子山古墳|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135504199}} - A kofun located in {{ill|Takasaki|en|Takasaki|qid=Q336438|lt=Takasaki}}, {{ill|Gunma Prefecture|en|Gunma Prefecture|qid=Q129499|lt=Gunma Prefecture}}. Designated as a National Historic Site as part of the {{ill|Hodota Kofun Cluster|en|Hodota Kofun Cluster|qid=Q11385853|lt=Hotoda Kofun Group}}.
* {{ill|Sōja Futagoyama Kofun|en|Sōja Futagoyama Kofun|qid=Q17222973|lt=Sōja Futagoyama Kofun}} - A kofun in Sōja Town, {{ill|Maebashi|en|Maebashi|qid=Q201613|lt=Maebashi}}, Gunma Prefecture (National Historic Site).
* {{ill|Maebashi Futagoyama Kofun|en|Maebashi Futagoyama Kofun|qid=Q17221378|lt=Maebashi Futagoyama Kofun}} - A kofun in Bunkyō Town, Maebashi, Gunma Prefecture (National Historic Site).
* {{ill|Gyōda Futagoyama Kofun|en|Gyōda Futagoyama Kofun|qid=Q11371449|lt=Futagoyama Kofun (Gyōda)}} - A kofun in {{ill|Gyōda|en|Gyōda|qid=Q860659|lt=Gyōda}}, {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|en|Saitama Prefecture|qid=Q128186|lt=Saitama Prefecture}}. Part of the {{ill|Sakitama Kofun Cluster|en|Sakitama Kofun Cluster|qid=Q2213580|lt=Sakitama Kofun Group}} and developed as {{ill|Sakitama Fudoki Hill|ja|さきたま古墳公園|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17224997}}.
* {{ill|Ōsu Futagoyama Kofun|ja|大須二子山古墳|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11441851}} - A former kofun located in {{ill|Nagoya|en|Nagoya|qid=Q11751|lt=Nagoya}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Ajiyoshi Futagoyama Kofun|en|Ajiyoshi Futagoyama Kofun|qid=Q11417036|lt=Ajiyoshi Futagoyama Kofun}} - A kofun in {{ill|Kasugai, Aichi|en|Kasugai, Aichi|qid=Q26101|lt=Kasugai}}, Aichi Prefecture (National Historic Site), with the surrounding area developed as {{ill|Futagoyama Park (Kasugai)|ja|二子山公園 (春日井市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q111098257}}.
* {{ill|Somoto Futagoyama Kofun|ja|曽本二子山古墳|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q38277894}} - A kofun in {{ill|Kōnan, Aichi|en|Kōnan, Aichi|qid=Q820496|lt=Kōnan}}, Aichi Prefecture.
* A kofun located in {{ill|Takatsuki|en|Takatsuki|qid=Q335423|lt=Takatuki}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|en|Osaka Prefecture|qid=Q122723|lt=Osaka Prefecture}} (managed by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ar|وكالة رعاية القصر الإمبراطوري|ca|Agència de la Casa Imperial|de|Kaiserliches Hofamt|es|Agencia de la Casa Imperial|fa|دفتر خاندان امپراتوری|fr|Agence impériale|ha|Hukumar Kula da Gidajen Daular|he|סוכנות משק הבית הקיסרי|hr|Uprava japanskog carskog dvora|id|Badan Rumah Tangga Kekaisaran|it|Agenzia della Casa Imperiale|ja|宮内庁|ko|일본 궁내청|lt|Imperatoriškosios šeimos agentūra|min|Badan Rumah Tanggo Kakaisaran|ms|Agensi Rumah Tangga Imperial|nl|Japans hof|pl|Agencja Dworu Cesarskiego|pt|Agência da Casa Imperial|ru|Управление Императорского двора Японии|simple|Imperial Household Agency|th|สำนักพระราชวังหลวง (ญี่ปุ่น)|tr|İmparatorluk Sarayı Ajansı|uk|Управління Імператорського двору Японії|vi|Cơ quan nội chính Hoàng gia Nhật Bản|zh|宫内厅|qid=Q1143602|lt=Imperial Household Agency}}) → See {{ill|Ōta Chausuyama Kofun#Baizuka|ja|太田茶臼山古墳#陪塚}}.
